If the value type for a custom property is invalid,
discard the property.

TODO(validation): Catch this error before trying to parse any value.
-- test.glx --
person_properties:
    custom_property_with_error:
        label: Custom Property with Error
        value_type: rabbit
    custom_property_well_formed:
        label: Custom Property Well Formed
        value_type: integer
persons:
    someone:
        properties:
            custom_property_with_error: 42
            custom_property_well_formed: 43

-- want-errors --
persons\[someone\].Properties.custom_property_with_error: value discarded: unknown value type "rabbit"
persons\[someone\].Properties.custom_property_with_error: entry discarded: has neither value nor fields
persons\[someone\].Properties.custom_property_with_error: property discarded: no entries

-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
    someone:
        properties:
            # custom_property_with_error discarded.
            custom_property_well_formed:
                definition:
                    label: Custom Property Well Formed
                    value_type: integer
                entries:
                -   value: IntValue{43}
